brief: Reactive Forge extracts React components into portable metadata, lets people compose them visually and exports the result to TSX. The mark should feel precise, structural and crafted, and avoid the React atom, </> brackets and flames.
criteria: Success: reads as an anvil at 16 px, carries a quiet JSX hint, works in one colour and reversed.

concepts.name: Self-closing anvil
concepts.idea: A blocky anvil whose slanted slot and pointed heel spell />, the end of a React component tag.
rationale: The cyan slash is a component slotted into the anvil
One angle language: 45° heel and base, 60° slot

recommendation: Self-closing anvil: ownable, legible at 16 px, and the /> hint rewards a second look without needing explanation.
next_steps: Add favicon set to the docs site
